title: Add durable projection storage and recovery

scope.assurance_scope: PCSM Python-v1 durable projection storage and recovery capability assessment for the exact current admitted source forest
scope.implementation_delta: Reuse and assess the current-head Kit persistence layers before proposing any new PCSM code. KitProofContextStateStore@0.1 supplies durable immutable byte/CID storage; HermeticProofSealStore and recover_seal_transitions@1 supply atomic object publication, durable WAL-prefix recovery, current-seal-pointer recognition, deterministic/idempotent recovery decisions, and stale-parent fencing. Neither layer defines a versioned PCSM ProjectionRoot record, binds a projection to an exact PCSM repository/tree/source-map CID, persists a named PCSM projection head, or recovers a PCSM projection. The exact declared-output boundary permits only this receipt, so no duplicate storage/recovery subsystem, wrapper, schema, or test mutation is created.
scope.non_promotion_reason: The requested complete capability is absent: current Kit recovery is seal-transition recovery, not PCSM projection recovery, and current proof_context tests contain no typed projection storage/recovery contract. The required sealed suite cannot import its conftest because aiohttp is unavailable with the mandated fresh HOME/XDG roots and PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1. Generic storage/recovery source and unexecuted tests are not promoted to an exact-PCSM implementation, successful validation, concrete source-forest projection, proof, or completion decision.

selected_existing_authority.minimum_delta_reason: The selected Kit layers are the closest reusable durability/recovery authorities already present at current head. Replacing or wrapping them would create a competing persistence/recovery authority; extending them with PCSM projection semantics would require source and direct tests outside this exact receipt-only dispatch.

components.role: Explicit-root durable facade over HermeticProofSealStore. It delegates immutable byte writes, verified reads, and CIDv1-base32 byte identity to artifacts helpers.
components.equivalence_limit: It accepts arbitrary bytes and has no ProjectionRoot schema, canonical projection serialization, named projection-head lookup, projection-CID-to-source-map/tree validation, projection recovery entry point, or recovery report.

components.role: Lower-layer immutable artifact store. Its object write path verifies bytes/CID, writes a temporary file, fsyncs the file, atomically replaces the object, and fsyncs the parent directory; duplicate bytes return the same artifact identity.
components.equivalence_limit: It persists generic artifact kinds rather than a typed PCSM projection; it does not own semantic authority, parse PCSM projections, bind a PCSM source forest, select canonical identity, or recover a named PCSM projection head.

components.role: Explicit-root deterministic and idempotent recovery of durable seal-transition WAL records. It emits only closed dispositions (resume, replay, verify-existing, discard-uncommitted, repair, full-reproof), recognizes current seal pointers, repairs corrupt WAL tails, and fences stale parents without inferring prover success.
components.equivalence_limit: Its durable unit is a seal transition keyed by repository_id/branch_id and current-seal pointer, not a PCSM projection. It has no PCSM ProjectionRoot schema, projection/alias records, exact PCSM tree/source-map fields, projection replay semantics, or direct proof_context exposure/test vector.

determinism_and_binding.available_binding: artifacts.cid_for_bytes derives CIDv1-base32 byte identity; the state facade verifies claimed-CID agreement on writes and recomputes identity on reads. Seal recovery has schema ipfs_kit_py/proof_seal_store/recovery@1, contract version 1, a closed disposition vocabulary, canonical decision sorting by repository_id/branch_id/transition_id, and idempotence/stale-parent rules documented in its public function.
determinism_and_binding.missing_binding: No versioned PCSM projection payload identifies a canonical projection CID, exact repository/tree/source-map CID, projection schema version, expected/result projection head, durable source-map proof, or recovery-result CID. No Kit byte CID, seal CID, current-seal pointer, or alias is treated as any of these absent semantic bindings.
determinism_and_binding.authority_boundary: Kit durability establishes exact-byte identity and seal-transition recovery only. It does not decide projection semantic correctness, select canonical semantic identity, authorize aliases, mutate PCSM source, authorize M2/M3 work, admit a projection, or make a completion/promotion decision. A future alias must remain non-canonical.
